transport_modes.description: Limited public corridor service with optional assigned cargo ships; versatile but inefficient for specialist freight.

transport_modes.name: Bulk Tug Service
transport_modes.description: Ships fitted with a Bulk Freight Array trade speed and fuel for efficient bulk and oversized transport.

transport_modes.description: Infrastructure service for high-throughput bulk freight between vacuum, low-gravity terminals; it needs no assigned ship but cannot handle precision or dangerous cargo.

transport_modes.name: Cryogenic Carrier Service
transport_modes.description: Insulated physical carriers efficiently move volatile cryogenic and hazardous cargo at higher energy and maintenance cost.

transport_modes.name: Express Courier Service
transport_modes.description: Advanced-drive couriers prioritize precision and urgent standard cargo with very short transit and handling time but high propellant cost.

activities.name: Manufacture Repair Supplies

activities.name: Robotic Heavy Section Fabrication
activities.description: Trade power, cooling and precision actuators for faster near-net-shape structural fabrication without scrap waste.

activities.name: Fabricate Precision Actuator

activities.name: Fabricate Power Bus Component

activities.name: Build Hull Armor

activities.name: Build High-Energy Systems Works
activities.description: Establish the third manufacturing regime for high-power, superconducting and radiation systems.

activities.name: Modernize Orbital Foundry
activities.description: Permanently modernize this manufacturing regime and raise its own throughput.

activities.name: Build Research Complex
activities.description: Create the infrastructure required for continuous research.

activities.name: Upgrade Research Complex
activities.description: Expand laboratories and computing support to accelerate all research projects.

activities.name: Build Microstructure Fabrication Array
activities.description: Establish the fourth manufacturing regime for photonics, advanced computing and microstructured systems.

activities.name: Build Field Engineering Complex
activities.description: Establish a controlled facility for exotic-crystal separation and coherent-field engineering.

activities.name: Build Frontier Matterworks
activities.description: Establish the contained matter-state facility required for repeatable dark-matter separation.

activities.name: Build Repair Dock
activities.description: Add persistent repair and refit support.

activities.name: Build Fusion Power Network

activities.name: Build Deep-space Command Array

activities.description: Build microstructured computing components from refined conductors, electronics and deterministic rare-earth feedstock.

activities.name: Assemble Basic Electronics
activities.description: Convert refined iron and copper stock into reliable basic electronics at the founding workshop, so starter stock is never a progression gate.

activities.name: Fabricate Data Core
activities.description: Encode hardened research storage from electronics and refined copper instead of random loot.

activities.name: Fabricate Superconducting Composite
activities.description: Prepare a cryogenic composite from refined copper and titanium alloy for high-field electrical systems.

activities.name: Wind Superconducting Coil
activities.description: Wind and validate a high-field superconducting coil.

activities.name: Fabricate Radiation-Hardened Electronics
activities.description: Package and test fault-tolerant electronics for high-radiation operation.

activities.name: Fabricate Prototype Propulsion Chamber
activities.description: Build a low-rate instrumented chamber for the active propulsion program; it remains a real industrial article, not research currency.

activities.name: Fabricate High-field Material Test Article
activities.description: Combine superconducting and radiation-hardened components into an instrumented engineering article for the Heavy Industry program.

activities.name: Refine Outer-system Superalloy
activities.description: Late-game vacuum alloy joining refined titanium and cobalt stock with process gas.

activities.name: Build Antimatter Cell
activities.description: Contained energy for deep-system projects.

activities.name: Assemble Civilization Project Core
activities.description: Reusable integration core first built as a Stellar Program prototype and later standardized for system-scale projects.

activities.name: Fabricate Logistics Handling Equipment
activities.description: Build powered loaders, grapples and transfer frames for remote ports and large construction sites.

activities.name: Fabricate Thermal Exchange Unit
activities.description: Build pumped high-flux heat rejection hardware for advanced power and vacuum industry.

activities.name: Fabricate Automated Control Core
activities.description: Integrate hardened computing and precision control for autonomous industrial coordination.

activities.name: Fabricate Construction Robotics
activities.description: Build reusable mobile manipulators for large orbital construction and remote industrial expansion.

activities.name: Build Advanced Drive
activities.description: Medium drive for Belt and Jovian routes using titanium and high-energy electronic controls.

activities.name: Build Plasma Cannon
activities.description: First-generation capital plasma weapon using Jovian alloys and quantum fire controls.

activities.name: Build Capital Shield
activities.description: Capital defense for outer-system threats.

activities.name: Build Stealth Array
activities.description: Alternative pirate-threat solution for mining and travel.

activities.name: Fabricate Repair Material
activities.description: Package refined iron and copper into deterministic fleet repair stock from the beginning of orbital industry.

activities.name: Prepare Thorium Service Fuel
activities.description: Purify separated thorium-bearing material into sealed maintenance fuel before fusion-system assembly.

activities.name: Fabricate Fusion Service Components
activities.description: Use steel, quantum controls and sealed thorium service fuel for maintainable fusion infrastructure, first as an experimental program article and later as a standard product.

activities.name: Build Stellar Forward Construction Base
activities.description: Establish real storage, power, unloading and construction support at the selected stellar site.

activities.name: Build Stellar Anchorage
activities.description: Create the load-bearing foundation and dedicated construction capacity.

activities.name: Assemble Stellar Primary Frame
activities.description: Raise the first truly massive collector-support structure from system-wide material flows.

activities.name: Install Stellar Energy Backbone
activities.description: Install high-field routing, power buses and physical thermal rejection capacity.

activities.name: Install Stellar Collector Systems
activities.description: Fit the main collector, control and conversion systems.

activities.name: Integrate Stellar Grid
activities.description: Integrate the collector, thermal and system power interfaces under sustained maintenance load.

activities.name: Commission Stellar Energy Megastructure
activities.description: Run the physical power, cooling, logistics and maintenance validation that completes the Sol-system industrial era.

research_projects.name: Advanced Propulsion Program
research_projects.description: Move from theory through a manufactured chamber and a real proving flight before industrial release.

routes.name: High-thrust Route
routes.description: Prioritize hot structures and chamber pressure.

routes.name: High-efficiency Route
routes.description: Prioritize electromagnetic control and propellant efficiency.

research_projects.description: Convert high-field material experiments into reusable precision and scale manufacturing methods.

research_projects.name: Jovian Fusion Energy Program
research_projects.description: Use experimental fusion engineering to build and operate a real power network before declaring the technology mature.

research_projects.name: Stellar Energy Megastructure Program

stages.name: Site Survey Review and Industrial Release

megastructures.name: Stellar Energy Megastructure
megastructures.description: The single Sol-system industrial endgame: a staged stellar collector and power-routing complex built by the entire industrial network.

goals.name: ESTABLISH ORBITAL INDUSTRY
goals.description: Use the square-grid factory to turn fixed deposits into iron, copper, structures and electronics.

goals.name: AUTOMATE NEAR-EARTH PRODUCTION
goals.description: Research Industrial Coordination and expand the square-grid factory with automated material flow.

goals.name: OPEN LUNAR SPACE
goals.description: Prepare the starter ship for exploration and establish the Lunar checkpoint.

goals.name: BREAK THE LUNAR BLOCKADE
goals.description: Defeat the Lunar Corsair while the Near-Earth industrial network continues operating automatically.

goals.name: SURVEY THE ASTEROID BELT
goals.description: Research long-range propulsion, commission the Lunar Pathfinder and establish the first Belt resource map.

goals.name: INDUSTRIALIZE AND SECURE THE BELT
goals.description: Build a heavy grid-factory base, commission the Belt Vanguard and destroy the pirate flagship blocking Jovian expansion.

goals.name: ESTABLISH JOVIAN OPERATIONS
goals.description: Develop a Cruiser, solve the gravity route and establish gas-resource production.

goals.name: ENTER THE OUTER SYSTEM
goals.description: Develop a Battleship and defeat the outer-system Dreadnought.

goals.name: CONTROL THE DEEP SYSTEM
goals.description: Commission the Titan, build Command Infrastructure and survive the final crisis.

goals.name: PREPARE THE STELLAR ENERGY PROGRAM
goals.description: Complete the engineering program, deeply survey a candidate site and commit the final construction location.

goals.name: COMPLETE THE STELLAR ENERGY MEGASTRUCTURE
goals.description: Feed the single eight-phase Sol-system endgame with real material, logistics, construction, power, cooling and maintenance capacity.
